tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers H ≤ 0.48, whereas the target horizon is 20. A slow-horizon measurement is needed to identify the adaptation timescale and discriminate the candidate mechanisms.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both time scales or the long-horizon adaptation.
The slow-horizon probe more directly resolves the forecast-horizon ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: Dual-horizon reversal and periodic oscillation models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-window pilot cannot distinguish their long-horizon behavior from the sink-coupled candidate.
